visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women, one wearing a tan newsboy cap and blue denim jacket, stand in front of the Rain Vortex waterfall at Jewel Changi Airport. The camera pans slightly to show the lush greenery and glass dome structure while a monorail train passes by in the background. (2) A close-up shot displays shelves stocked with red and white Ferrari-branded caps and jackets inside a brightly lit retail store environment. (3) The scene shifts to the women walking down a street lined with vibrant, colorful shophouses featuring traditional architectural details under bright, natural daylight. (4) The visuals cut to a concert venue where several male performers in black and white stylized outfits are dancing and singing on a large stage under intense spotlights and LED screens. (5) A hand holds a clear cup filled with pale green sugarcane juice with ice, followed by a shot of a whole green coconut with a yellow straw. (6) Several grilled chicken wings are shown on a white plastic plate, and one is held by a hand and dipped into a small bowl containing red chili sauce. (7) A nighttime city view from a high-rise balcony shows illuminated skyscrapers and urban greenery against a dark sky. (8) Hands are seen taking a dark, square-shaped piece of meat jerky out of a red and yellow 'Lim Chee Guan' branded paper bag. (9) A large serving of black pepper crab mixed with vermicelli noodles is stirred with a metal spoon in a dining setting. (10) A plastic container of yellow durian ice cream is shown as a white plastic spoon scoops a portion out. (11) The final scene returns to the airport waterfall, where the two women stand together smiling, holding a black shopping bag and gesturing toward the camera.
